objects.text: Data-driven Digital Marketing Specialist with 5+ years of mid-level experience developing and scaling digital campaigns across SEO, PPC, email, and social media channels. Adept at increasing conversion rates by 30%+ and driving cost-per-lead reductions through targeted optimization strategies. Passionate about leveraging analytics to influence strategic marketing decisions and enhance brand presence.
Digital Marketing Specialist — BrightWave Tech Solutions
• Spearheaded PPC campaigns that boosted qualified lead volume by 45% year-over-year while decreasing cost-per-click by 20%.
• Led an integrated content marketing campaign increasing organic traffic by 38%, contributing to a 25% uplift in monthly sales conversions.
• Optimized email marketing workflows which improved click-through rate by 15% and reduced unsubscribe rate by 7% over six months.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to launch retargeting strategies that raised customer retention by 18% within one year.
• Managed social media advertising campaigns that attained a 30% increase in engagement and contributed to a 22% increase in direct online sales.
• Implemented SEO improvements resulting in a 40% increase in site visibility and a 33% growth in organic lead generation.
• Coordinated campaign analytics reporting that informed budget allocation, improving marketing ROI by 17%.
• Produced monthly marketing metrics dashboards that enhanced understanding of channel performance among senior leadership.
Bachelor of Business Administration in Marketing, Pacific Grove University, 2018
